metadata.title: SPARC Azure Container Registry Component Definition

components.title: Azure Container Registry (ACR)
components.description: Private registry for the SPARC + NGINX images the container app pulls. Admin user disabled; pulls use the container app's managed identity (AcrPull). Deployed via Terraform (Azure/ACK/modules/container_registry/). <!-- UPDATE: insert the ACR resource ID and login server. Premium SKU adds private endpoint, geo-replication, and content trust. -->

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control implementations for Azure Container Registry

implemented-requirements.description: Identification and Authentication: The registry admin user is disabled; the container app pulls images using its managed identity granted the AcrPull role, avoiding stored registry credentials. Reference: DISA SRG-APP-000148, CIS Azure.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Terraform: azurerm_container_registry.main admin_enabled=false; azurerm_role_assignment AcrPull on the container app principal.

implemented-requirements.description: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity: Image integrity is provided by the container-build-sign cosign pipeline (signatures verified at deploy) rather than ACR content-trust. Premium SKU can additionally enable image quarantine/scan. Reference: DISA SRG-APP.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Signing handled in risk-sentinel/container-build-sign; ACR SKU var controls Premium features (private endpoint, geo-replication, quarantine).
